instructions: Only listed, pinned and verified source fonts may contribute precomputed vector outlines. Preserve the full OFL notice in the published bundle. Additional fonts require independent review.

approvals.reviewer: repository license + upstream pinned revision cross-check
approvals.notes: The local font Git blob and upstream license match pinned upstream. Derived outlines are redistributed with complete copyright notice and SIL OFL 1.1, without assigning a reserved font name to a modified font.
